description: Held-out shape classes in the Stage 1 v2 TEST split only (500 images each). Not shown to any base model, baseline, or WSP writer. Names appear only in data/heldout.py and in this file.

heldout.name: crescent
heldout.style: filled disk minus an offset disk

heldout.name: heptagon
heldout.style: regular seven-sided outline, visually close to the hexagon new class

history: The first held-out pair was crescent and trapezoid (chosen before calibration). Before any Stage 1 v2 condition ran, trapezoid was replaced by heptagon at the user's request, so that one held-out shape is near the new class and one is far. The frozen data configuration and the calibration are unchanged; only test data for the held-out classes changed.
metrics: Held-out false-positive rate (fraction predicted as class 9) is reported separately for the near and the far shape, and overall.
